column3: Close to the Hebrew; NASB supplies “some of,” and renders “made bow down” as “subdued.”
Close to the Hebrew; “He atoned for” is rendered “forgave,” and “He increased to turn back” as “often He restrained.”
Close to the Hebrew; NASB supplies “but.”
Close to the Hebrew; “they returned and tested” is rendered “again and again they tempted.”
Close to the Hebrew; “His hand” is rendered “His power.”
Close to the Hebrew; “the region of Zoan” is rendered “the field of Zoan.”
Close to the Hebrew; the rare word rendered “frost” is of uncertain meaning.
Close to the Hebrew; “angels of calamities” is rendered “destroying angels.”
“The territory of His holiness” is rendered “His holy land,” and “the mountain” as “this hill country.”
“He made them fall by a measuring line of inheritance” is rendered “He apportioned them for an inheritance by measurement.”
Close to the Hebrew; “idols” is rendered “graven images.”
